topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Well, now, I never did fancy gettin’ much from the earth, just enough to make do. But today, a raven-haired lad from the village, young Thomas, who I taught to count his sheep and read the signs of the seasons, he come by with a bundle wrapped in twine. It ain’t often we get such thoughtful gestures, and I reckon this one gave me a queer feeling, like the first green buds of spring pushin’ through the thaw. He said it was somethin’ for all the lessons, but it felt like more. More than just a season’s work, more like a seed planted and now it’s reached out to me. I’ll have to reckon what to say when he comes back, maybe a tale or two from the fields, somethin’ to send him on his way, grateful.
